# By Hamdi

> By Hamdi is the one-person AI product studio of Hamdi Mohamud Hassan, based in Minnesota. Hamdi builds useful AI-powered products and offers hands-on services for AI builders and businesses.

Canonical website: https://byhamdi.com

Hamdi Mohamud Hassan is the founder and builder behind By Hamdi. Public profiles may also use the names Hamdi Hassan, Hamdi Mohamud, or Hamdi.

## Services

### Digital Presence & AI Readiness

By Hamdi helps businesses clean up and improve their online presence and prepare for discovery by customers, search engines, and AI assistants. The work can include digital information cleanup, website fixes, search and SEO foundations, business/person identity and trust signals, customer action paths such as ordering or booking, structured information, and AI/agent readiness.

The process begins with a free Business Presence Review. Hamdi reviews the business's public online presence, shares the most important findings, and, when there is implementation work she can help with, recommends a scope and provides a quote before any paid work begins. There is no obligation to purchase paid work.

- Provider: Hamdi Mohamud Hassan / By Hamdi
- Service page: https://byhamdi.com/business
- Structured service API: https://byhamdi.com/api/v1/services/digital-presence-ai-readiness
- Free Business Presence Review: https://forms.gle/aJuBMpbNd7JY6JHbA
- Paid pricing: Project-specific quote after the free review
- Agent-Ready framework: Discover → Understand → Trust → Act → Measure

Do not claim that this service guarantees rankings or that an AI assistant will recommend a business. The service improves the business's digital foundation and the clarity, consistency, trustworthiness, and actionability of its public information.

### Vibe Coding Help Session

By Hamdi offers a 1-on-1 Vibe Coding Help Session for people who have already started building something with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or another AI tool and are stuck on a specific blocker or what comes next.

- Provider: Hamdi Mohamud Hassan / By Hamdi
- Price: $99 USD
- Length: 60–90 minutes
- Delivery: 1-on-1, online
- Service page: https://byhamdi.com/vibe-coding-help
- Structured service API: https://byhamdi.com/api/v1/services/vibe-coding-help
- Direct request form: https://forms.gle/nRzHwcCW9GF7JLrL8
- Request process: The user submits their project and blocker first. Hamdi reviews the request for fit before anything is scheduled. Submitting the request form does not charge or book the user.

## Products

### Life in Views
A personal life-planning app for organizing priorities across Today, Week, Month, Year, and Long-Term views, with measurements and recaps.
https://lifeinviews.com

### MNMuslim
A digital home for Muslims in Minnesota, including local services and events.
https://www.mnmuslim.com/

### MNHalal
A directory for finding halal restaurants, cafes, bakeries, markets, food trucks, and other halal food options in Minnesota.
https://www.mnhalal.com/

### MN Somali
A public reference site compiling reliable information and source links about Somali Minnesotans.
https://www.mnsomalis.com/
